properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.yaml Inference.rule; inference.rs InferenceRule::Immediate, combine, add_inference). Rule `immediate` holds on no premise, reads any premises as `all` (what it is grasped in), reads "not an inference: an immediate grasp", and an objection can still aim at it; add_inference accepts it with no premise, and every other rule still needs one.
properties.name: A step can be an immediate grasp, not an inference (rule immediate)
